title: MLX90640 - Student job at Advionics NV
shortDescription: A production-ready system for monitoring and analyzing real-time data from multiple thermal cameras, with abnormal temperature detection.
description:
This project involved designing and implementing a robust application to manage and analyze real-time data from several MLX90640 thermal camera modules. The system features monitoring, automated alerting for abnormal temperature readings, and a user-friendly interface for data visualization.
The solution was successfully deployed to production and is actively used for thermal monitoring in a professional environment at Advionics NV.
